goal: Slice 2b: add a configurable RTSP network-camera source (Tapo TC73 is the leading option) with reconnect handling and a stale/disconnected indicator so frozen video never looks live; credentials kept out of logs; tested with simulated streams.
completed: RtspSource (camera/source.py): any URL OpenCV/FFmpeg can open, TCP transport + socket timeout via OPENCV_FFMPEG_CAPTURE_OPTIONS set before the first import, FFmpeg logging silenced; no new dependency.
camera/redact.py: redact_url(), split_credentials(), with_credentials() with URL-encoding round trip; applied to every error string, repr, status field, and CLI line. Settings.__repr__ masks secrets.
camera/placeholder.py: embedded 480x270 'NO SIGNAL / reconnecting' JPEG rendered once with OpenCV.

Hub rewrite (camera/hub.py): supervisor thread over disposable reader threads (one per connection generation); hang detection abandons a stuck reader and starts the next after backoff (1 s doubling to 30 s, reset on first good frame); reconnecting stops when nobody watches; mjpeg() streams the placeholder once per second while stale/disconnected with X-Kona-State part headers; snapshot() returns (jpeg, state); status() reports state/age/generation/opens/reconnects/last_error.

Web: KONA_CAMERA_SOURCE usb|rtsp|fake, KONA_RTSP_URL/USER/PASSWORD (embedded credentials split out), KONA_STALE_SECONDS, KONA_HANG_SECONDS; gated /status.json; snapshot always 200 with X-Kona-State; camera.html polls status into the existing #dot/#cap; two CSS classes (.dot.stale, .dot.off).
CLI: `kona camera-test` (opens the configured camera once, prints size/fps/bytes, redacted URL, exact error); `kona serve` prints the redacted camera label.

39 tests green incl. scripted-source hub tests (dropped reads, mid-stream exception, hung read abandoned+replaced, stale->live, status transitions, backoff, stop) and a real OpenCV+FFmpeg network read against an in-process HTTP MJPEG server.

Live check: uvicorn with a source that dies after 3 s and is refused for 4 s showed live -> disconnected -> stale -> live on /stream.mjpg; 3 reconnects reported; the password appeared nowhere in the stream or log.
docs/slice-2b-rtsp-plan.md with Tapo setup steps; PROJECT.md updated; 4 commits pushed to claude/nice-bohr-6tnfn0.

/security-review found one MEDIUM: a scheme-less KONA_RTSP_URL (e.g. 192.168.1.10:554/stream1) or a raw '/' in an embedded password slipped past the redactor and put the password in /status.json and camera-test output. Fixed at three layers (errors built from the bare URL only; shape-agnostic redactor; settings refuse scheme-less URLs) with tests for each reproduced input. 45 tests green after the fix.

Windows CI caught a race in the snapshot-on-dead-camera test; root cause was real (a viewer waited its full timeout on a dead camera). _wait_frame now wakes on reader death; suite stable 3/3 locally, CI green on ubuntu + windows at 5dad045.
discovered: OpenCV 5.0 wheel's FFmpeg opens HTTP MJPEG URLs fine in the sandbox, which gives a hardware-free test of the network capture path; RTSP itself still needs a real server/camera.
A hub that reconnects only while viewers exist makes 'reconnects after failure' tests wrong unless the test holds a viewer; the idle stop is a feature, not a bug.
With a reconnect backoff shorter than the stale window the recovery is seamless and no placeholder is ever shown; tests that want to see the gap must set backoff > stale_after.
PR #1 (Astro's probe fixes) is still open and unmerged; branch unchanged otherwise.
urllib.parse.urlsplit stops the netloc at the first '/', so a raw '/' inside an embedded password silently moves the credentials into the path; and hostname/port round-tripping strips IPv6 brackets.
decisions: Frozen-never-looks-live is enforced server-side (placeholder frames in the stream itself), with the status label as a second, optional layer.

Hung reads are handled by abandoning the reader thread and starting a new generation; a thread stuck in a C call cannot be killed, so this is the only in-process recovery. Known limit: lingering threads during hours of flapping, bounded by the backoff cap.
RTSP credentials: separate .env keys are canonical; an embedded-credential URL is tolerated but split and redacted.
Defaults: stale after 3 s, hang after 10 s, backoff 1 s to 30 s, TCP transport.
Template/CSS touch limited to the status script and two .dot classes; Claude Design owns the look of the states.
lessons: When applying multi-file edits via a script, run ruff format first or anchor on post-format text; one reformatted line silently aborted half the edits.
Assert on behaviour the design promises (reconnected, resumed, redacted) rather than on timing-dependent intermediate states unless the timing is pinned in the test.
Generate binary fixtures with the real encoder and embed the bytes; never hand-write JPEG hex.

A credential redactor keyed on URL shape fails exactly on the malformed inputs users type; build messages from a string that never held the secret, and make the matcher shape-agnostic. Have the security review try the typo cases, not just the happy path.

Windows runners are slower and expose timing assumptions in thread tests; assert on 'not live' rather than on which non-live state, and make waits wake on state changes instead of relying on timeouts.
